Latin word

nātūrālis

nātūrālis, nātūrāle

adjective, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

biological (of a parent), by birth; natural, of nature, produced by nature

In this lexicon

  • biological

    also used · classical · Cic. Phil. 3.15: nātūrālis pater, opposed to the adoptive father (Lewis & Short); Liv. 42.52 (Lewis & Short)

  • natural

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 21.4.6: dēsīderiō nātūrālī; Cic. Brut. 36: nātūrālis, nōn fūcātus nitor (Lewis & Short)

  • ambitus nātūrālis: nature

    modern

Examples

  • Pater ejus nātūrālis in Graeciā vīvit.

    His biological father lives in Greece.composed

    In the entry for biological

  • cibī pōtiōnisque dēsīderiō nātūrālī, nōn voluptāte modus fīnītus

    what he ate and drank was measured by natural need, not by pleasureLiv. 21.4.6

    In the entry for natural

  • fīcī enim sēmen nātūrāle intus in eā fīcō, quam edimus, quae sunt minūta grāna

    for the fig’s natural seed is inside the fig we eat: the tiny grainsVarr. RR 1.41.4

    In the entry for natural
